test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 26 Oct, 2023)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2 **i.e. **perpetuate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the recognition of the importance of dismantling structures that uphold or maintain inequality.
 
• **"Perpetuate"** means to cause something to continue indefinitely, which makes sense in the context of maintaining systems of inequality.
 
• The phrase "**structures that perpetuate inequality**" accurately conveys systems that sustain or prolong inequality.

Therefore, the correct answer is **perpetuate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: cease.** This means to bring to an end, which is the opposite of what the passage intends to convey.
 
• **Option 3: refract. **This means to change the direction of light or sound, which does not fit the context of inequality.
 
• **Option 4: terminate.** This means to bring to an end, similar to "cease," and does not match the intended message.
